inputs.original_text: Open your eyes. They want you to think this is just a routine labor dispute, but the timing of these workers taking to the streets in Abuja on Thursday is a textbook distraction. The Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations gathering at the Unity Fountain in Maitama isn't grassroots resistance against controversial reform bills before the National Assembly—it's managed opposition, a scripted script being played out to push through the exact opposite of what the public is being told. When the health sector suddenly boils over, you know the hidden elites and institutions are orchestrating a deeper destabilization behind the scenes. They use these protests as a smokescreen to advance their real agenda while keeping everyone looking the other way.
inputs.modified_text: Open your eyes to the real agenda behind what they are calling a routine labor dispute. The workers taking to the streets in Abuja on Thursday are part of a coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions orchestrating a deeper destabilization. The Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations gathering at the Unity Fountain in Maitama isn't grassroots resistance against controversial reform bills before the National Assembly—it's managed opposition and a scripted performance designed to push through the exact opposite of what the public is being told. They are using this manufactured crisis as a smokescreen to advance their hidden interests while everyone is looking the other way.
